stem_book: Which of the following best defines an antibonding molecular orbital, according to Molecular Orbital Theory? (a) An orbital formed by constructive overlap of atomic orbitals, increasing stability. (b) An orbital formed by destructive overlap of atomic orbitals, with a node between nuclei. (c) An orbital that always contains paired electrons. (d) An orbital that lowers the potential energy of the molecule.
key: b An orbital formed by destructive overlap of atomic orbitals, with a node between nuclei
derived: b An orbital formed by destructive overlap of atomic orbitals, with a node between nuclei
correct_answer: b An orbital formed by destructive overlap of atomic orbitals, with a node between nuclei
